from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class DocumentCaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document for classification."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The specific title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_types: List[Literal["刑事案件", "执行案件", "民事案件", "行政案件", "赔偿案件"]] = Field(description="The case category/categories identified in this document, drawn from the 5 task-defined types")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates information from all parsed documents."""
    documents: List[DocumentCaseInfo]
